words.enDefinition: a hospital entrance leading directly to emergency care

examples.en: My flatmate read the map aloud while I looked for the emergency entrance sign.
examples.zh: 我找「急诊入口」标牌时，室友把地图上的说明念给我听。

examples.en: The security guard pointed out the emergency entrance from the far end of the car park.
examples.zh: 保安从停车场另一头指给我看「急诊入口」的位置。

words.enDefinition: a designated area where ambulances bring patients to hospital

examples.en: I waited by the public doors while the crew pulled up at the ambulance bay.
examples.zh: 我在公众入口等着，救护人员把车开到了「救护车停靠区」。

examples.en: The map marks the ambulance bay separately from the entrance used by people arriving on foot.
examples.zh: 地图上，「救护车停靠区」和步行到院人员使用的入口是分开标注的。

words.enDefinition: the front desk for visitors arriving for emergency care

examples.en: My friend asked emergency reception where family members could wait for an update from staff.
examples.zh: 朋友问「急诊接待处」，家属可以在哪里等工作人员的消息。

examples.en: The hospital moved emergency reception closer to the main doors during the renovations last month.
examples.zh: 医院上个月翻修时，把「急诊接待处」搬到了更靠近大门的位置。

words.enDefinition: the process of registering a patient's arrival for emergency care

examples.en: The clerk asked for my date of birth during emergency check-in at the hospital.
examples.zh: 医院「急诊登记」时，接待人员问了我的出生日期。

examples.en: My roommate stayed with me during emergency check-in and helped confirm my contact number.
examples.zh: 室友陪我做了「急诊登记」，帮我确认了联系电话。

words.enDefinition: to reach a medical facility in an ambulance

examples.en: The clerk asked whether my friend would arrive by ambulance or his roommate would drive him.
examples.zh: 接待人员问我朋友会「乘救护车到院」，还是由室友开车送他。

examples.en: She said I would arrive by ambulance at the hospital on the other side of town.
examples.zh: 她说我会「乘救护车到」城另一头的医院。

collocations: arrive by ambulance at the hospital

words.enDefinition: to come to a healthcare facility on your own initiative

examples.en: The form asked whether I had been referred or had chosen to self-present that evening.
examples.zh: 表格问我当天晚上是经转诊来的，还是「自行到院就诊」。

examples.en: I chose to self-present after checking which hospital entrance was open that evening.
examples.zh: 我确认了那天晚上医院哪个入口开放后，决定「自行到院就诊」。

words.enDefinition: the way in which a patient reached the facility

examples.en: We checked the arrival mode on the report because the clerk had recorded it incorrectly.
examples.zh: 接待人员记错了，我们核对了报告上的「到院方式」。

examples.en: The nurse confirmed my arrival mode before attaching the earlier notes to my hospital record.
examples.zh: 护士先确认了我的「到院方式」，再把之前的记录附到院内病历上。

words.enDefinition: the staff working together on an ambulance

examples.en: The ambulance crew spoke with the hospital nurse while my roommate waited by the doors.
examples.zh: 「救护车工作人员」和医院护士沟通时，我室友在门边等着。

examples.en: I handed my friend's bag to the ambulance crew before following them inside the hospital.
examples.zh: 跟着进医院前，我把朋友的包交给了「救护车工作人员」。

words.enDefinition: a trained clinician providing emergency care outside a hospital

examples.en: The paramedic introduced herself and asked which hospital my previous records were kept at.
examples.zh: 「院前急救医护人员」做了自我介绍，问我之前的病历存在哪家医院。

examples.en: My friend remembered the paramedic explaining where the ambulance would take us that evening.
examples.zh: 我朋友记得「院前急救医护人员」说明过，那天晚上救护车会送我们去哪儿。

words.enDefinition: a worker trained to provide basic prehospital emergency care

examples.en: The emergency medical technician wrote down the number my roommate gave him for the hospital.
examples.zh: 「急救医疗技术员」记下了室友提供的号码，准备交给医院。

examples.en: I asked the emergency medical technician where the crew would take my friend that evening.
examples.zh: 我问「急救医疗技术员」，那天晚上救护人员会把我朋友送去哪儿。

collocations: work as an emergency medical technician
speak to an emergency medical technician

words.enDefinition: a doctor working in hospital emergency care

examples.en: The emergency physician reviewed my notes and told me who would come to speak next.
examples.zh: 「急诊医生」看了我的记录，告诉我接下来会有谁来沟通。

examples.en: I asked the emergency physician to explain which department would receive the records after our visit.
examples.zh: 我请「急诊医生」说明这次就诊结束后，哪个科室会接收记录。

words.enDefinition: a nurse who works in hospital emergency care

examples.en: An emergency nurse checked the name on my wristband before bringing me to another room.
examples.zh: 一位「急诊护士」先核对了我腕带上的姓名，再带我去另一个房间。

examples.en: I asked the emergency nurse which desk my friend should use to ask for an update.
examples.zh: 我问「急诊护士」，朋友想打听最新情况该去哪个服务台。

words.enDefinition: a nurse assessing urgency when patients first arrive

examples.en: The triage nurse asked what had happened before writing down the time of my arrival.
examples.zh: 「分诊护士」先问发生了什么，再记下我的到院时间。

examples.en: I gave the triage nurse a short account of what my friend had told me.
examples.zh: 我把朋友之前告诉我的情况简单说给了「分诊护士」。

words.enDefinition: the medical specialty dealing with urgent illness and injury

examples.en: The doctor said she worked in emergency medicine rather than on one of the hospital wards.
examples.zh: 医生说自己从事「急诊医学」，不在医院病区工作。

examples.en: My course invited a specialist in emergency medicine to explain how the local department was organized.
examples.zh: 我的课程请了一位「急诊医学」专家来介绍当地急诊科的组织方式。

words.enDefinition: short-term care for illnesses or injuries needing prompt attention

examples.en: The nurse explained the difference between acute care and the follow-up service near my campus.
examples.zh: 护士解释了「急性期医疗」和校园附近的复诊服务有什么区别。

examples.en: The hospital brochure described acute care and listed where people could ask questions about visits.
examples.zh: 医院手册介绍了「急性期医疗」，还列出了可以咨询就诊问题的地方。

words.enDefinition: a British service that assesses and treats less serious injuries

examples.en: The hospital map showed the minor injuries unit in a separate building behind the main entrance.
examples.zh: 医院地图显示，「轻伤门诊」在主入口后面一栋单独的楼里。

examples.en: The receptionist called the minor injuries unit to check where my friend's notes had been sent.
examples.zh: 前台打电话给「轻伤门诊」，核实我朋友的记录送到了哪里。

words.enDefinition: assessment that prioritizes patients according to urgency

examples.en: The sign explained that triage happens before most people are taken to a treatment bay.
examples.zh: 告示说明，大多数人会先做「分诊」，再由工作人员带去诊疗区。

examples.en: I asked my tutor what triage meant after seeing the word on the hospital paperwork.
examples.zh: 我在医院文件上看到「分诊」这个词，就问了导师它是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a station where staff organize or carry out triage

examples.en: I asked the person at the triage desk where my roommate could leave my bag.
examples.zh: 我问「分诊台」的工作人员，室友可以把我的包放在哪儿。

examples.en: The signs led from the hospital entrance to the triage desk next to reception.
examples.zh: 从医院入口沿着标牌走，可以到接待处旁的「分诊台」。

collocations: speak to someone at the triage desk

words.enDefinition: a level assigned to reflect how urgently care is needed

examples.en: The nurse explained what the triage category meant when I asked about my wait.
examples.zh: 我问还要等多久，护士解释了「分诊等级」是什么意思。

examples.en: The triage category appeared in my record next to the time I first arrived.
examples.zh: 我的病历上在首次到院时间旁标了「分诊等级」。

words.enDefinition: how serious or urgent a patient's condition is

examples.en: The notice explained that patient acuity can affect the order in which people are seen.
examples.zh: 告示解释说，「患者病情紧急程度」会影响就诊顺序。

examples.en: My instructor explained patient acuity when we discussed the language on a hospital dashboard.
examples.zh: 我们讨论医院信息板上的用词时，老师解释了「患者病情紧急程度」。

words.enDefinition: the sequence in which people came to a facility

examples.en: The receptionist said the order of arrival was recorded but did not determine every wait.
examples.zh: 前台说会记录「到院先后顺序」，但等待时长并不完全由它决定。

examples.en: I asked whether the list on the screen followed the order of arrival that evening.
examples.zh: 我问那天晚上屏幕上的名单是不是按「到院先后顺序」排的。

collocations: according to the order of arrival

words.enDefinition: with the most urgent people or issues dealt with first

examples.en: The board said people were usually seen in order of urgency rather than arrival time.
examples.zh: 公告板说，通常是「按紧急程度」看诊，不是按到达时间。

examples.en: The nurse explained that referrals were reviewed in order of urgency throughout the evening.
examples.zh: 护士解释说，整晚的转诊申请都是「按紧急程度」审查的。

words.enDefinition: a first assessment carried out when someone reaches a service

examples.en: The nurse recorded the assessment on arrival and read back the notes to confirm them.
examples.zh: 护士记录了「到院初评」，并把记录读给我听作了确认。

examples.en: I asked where the assessment on arrival would take place after checking at the front desk.
examples.zh: 去前台确认后，我问在哪里做「到院初评」。

collocations: notes from the assessment on arrival

words.enDefinition: another review of a situation after an earlier evaluation

examples.en: The nurse returned for a reassessment and asked what had changed during the wait.
examples.zh: 护士回来做「再次评估」，问我等候期间有什么变化。

examples.en: I checked whether my reassessment would take place in the same room as before.
examples.zh: 我确认「再次评估」是不是在之前那个房间做。

words.enDefinition: a written record of the first prioritization assessment

examples.en: I saw the triage note at the top of the folder when the nurse opened it.
examples.zh: 护士打开文件夹时，我看到最上面是「分诊记录」。

examples.en: The doctor read the triage note before asking me to confirm the details of my arrival.
examples.zh: 医生先阅读了「分诊记录」，再请我确认到院时的相关情况。

words.enDefinition: the time at which a condition or symptom began

examples.en: I checked my messages to estimate the time of onset before answering the nurse's question.
examples.zh: 我先翻了翻消息，估算症状「开始出现的时间」，然后回答了护士的问题。

examples.en: The doctor asked if anyone with me could help confirm the time of onset.
examples.zh: 医生问和我在一起的人能不能帮忙确认「开始出现的时间」。

collocations: ask about the time of onset

words.enDefinition: the time at which an injury happened

examples.en: I estimated the time of injury by checking when I had phoned my flatmate.
examples.zh: 我查看了自己给室友打电话的时间，估算了「受伤时间」。

examples.en: The nurse confirmed the time of injury before adding the details to the record.
examples.zh: 护士先确认了「受伤时间」，再把细节加到记录里。

words.enDefinition: the event or force by which an injury occurred

examples.en: The nurse asked about the mechanism of injury, so I described how I had fallen.
examples.zh: 护士问到「受伤方式」，我就描述了自己是怎么摔倒的。

examples.en: The report described the mechanism of injury and noted where it happened on campus.
examples.zh: 报告描述了「受伤方式」，并记录了校园里发生意外的位置。

collocations: ask about the mechanism of injury

words.enDefinition: a description of how the current health problem developed

examples.en: The clinician checked my history of present illness before asking about changes since that morning.
examples.zh: 医务人员先查看了我的「现病史」，再问从那天早上起有什么变化。

examples.en: The history of present illness section covered the events that led to my visit.
examples.zh: 「现病史」一栏记录了这次来就诊的前因后果。

collocations: take the history of present illness
document the history of present illness
a brief history of present illness

words.enDefinition: the explanation for why someone came for care

examples.en: The clerk asked me to give my reason for attendance in one short sentence.
examples.zh: 接待人员请我用一句简短的话说明「就诊原因」。

examples.en: The report listed my reason for attendance next to the date of the visit.
examples.zh: 报告上把我的「就诊原因」列在就诊日期旁边。

words.enDefinition: the calendar date on which someone attended a service

examples.en: I checked the date of attendance because the visit had started close to midnight.
examples.zh: 因为就诊开始时已经接近午夜，我核对了「到院就诊日期」。

examples.en: The hospital letter included the date of attendance but did not list every test.
examples.zh: 医院的信上写了「到院就诊日期」，但没有列出所有检查。

collocations: an entry for the date of attendance

words.enDefinition: the clock time at which someone reached the facility

examples.en: The clerk asked us to confirm the arrival time shown on the hospital screen.
examples.zh: 接待人员请我们确认医院屏幕上显示的「到院时间」。

examples.en: I wrote down the arrival time while my roommate parked the car across the street.
examples.zh: 室友把车停到街对面时，我记下了「到院时间」。

words.enDefinition: new information given to people waiting for emergency care

examples.en: The waiting room update warned that staff were still dealing with several earlier arrivals.
examples.zh: 「候诊进度通知」说，工作人员还在处理几位之前到院的患者。

examples.en: My roommate heard a waiting room update while I was speaking with the receptionist.
examples.zh: 我正在和前台说话时，室友听到了「候诊进度通知」。

collocations: listen for a waiting room update

words.enDefinition: to wait until a clinician is able to assess you

examples.en: I was asked to wait for assessment in the area beside the main nursing station.
examples.zh: 工作人员让我在主护士站旁边的区域「等待评估」。

examples.en: My friend stayed with me while I continued to wait for assessment that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午我一直「等待评估」，朋友留在那里陪我。

collocations: wait for assessment in the designated area

words.enDefinition: whether a service has a free hospital bed

examples.en: The team said bed availability would affect when my friend could move to the ward.
examples.zh: 团队说，「床位可用情况」会影响我朋友什么时候能转去病房。

examples.en: I asked whether bed availability was the reason the transfer had not happened yet.
examples.zh: 我问转运迟迟没安排，是不是因为「床位可用情况」。

words.enDefinition: keeping admitted patients in emergency care while beds are unavailable

examples.en: The hospital explained emergency department boarding while my family asked about the delayed ward transfer.
examples.zh: 我家人问转病房为什么延误时，医院解释了什么是「急诊滞留待住院床位」。

examples.en: A patient liaison described emergency department boarding in the leaflet given to my roommate.
examples.zh: 患者联络员在给我室友的折页里介绍了「急诊滞留待住院床位」。

words.enDefinition: the movement of patients through steps in a service

examples.en: The hospital changed the reception layout to improve patient flow during the busiest hours.
examples.zh: 医院调整了接待区布局，改善高峰时段的「患者流转」。

examples.en: My lecturer used patient flow to describe how people move between the assessment areas.
examples.zh: 老师用「患者流转」来描述患者如何在各个评估区之间流动。

words.enDefinition: an administrative worker who handles records and arrivals in emergency care

examples.en: The emergency department clerk checked my friend into the system and printed a label.
examples.zh: 「急诊科行政接待员」把我朋友登记入院内系统，并打印了标签。

examples.en: I asked the emergency department clerk which entrance my flatmate should use to meet me.
examples.zh: 我问「急诊科行政接待员」，室友该走哪个入口来找我。

collocations: speak to the emergency department clerk
check with an emergency department clerk
an emergency department clerk at reception

words.enDefinition: a nurse responsible for overseeing a unit on a shift

examples.en: The charge nurse checked which room was available before directing us to the next area.
examples.zh: 「值班主管护士」先确认哪个房间空着，再指引我们去下一区域。

examples.en: My roommate asked the charge nurse where she could wait for news about the transfer.
examples.zh: 室友问「值班主管护士」，她可以在哪里等转运消息。

words.enDefinition: a very serious and potentially unstable medical state

examples.en: The staff member explained that critical condition was the term used in the latest update.
examples.zh: 工作人员说明，最新通报里用的是「病情危重」这个词。

examples.en: My friend listened while the nurse explained what critical condition meant in the written report.
examples.zh: 朋友听护士解释书面报告中「病情危重」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a difference in the way a patient is doing

examples.en: The nurse asked when we first noticed a change in condition during the wait.
examples.zh: 护士问我们在等候期间最早是什么时候注意到「病情变化」的。

examples.en: The doctor added a note to the record describing a change in condition that evening.
examples.zh: 医生在病历上加了一条备注，描述了那天晚上的「病情变化」。

words.enDefinition: a space where hospital staff carry out patient assessments

examples.en: The nurse directed me to an assessment bay across the corridor from the waiting area.
examples.zh: 护士指引我去候诊区走廊对面的「评估区隔间」。

examples.en: My flatmate waited by the doors while I was called into the assessment bay.
examples.zh: 我被叫进「评估区隔间」时，室友在门边等着。

collocations: direct someone to an assessment bay

words.enDefinition: a small separated area used for examining or treating patients

examples.en: The porter took me to a treatment cubicle while my roommate waited nearby with my bag.
examples.zh: 运送人员把我送到一个「诊疗隔间」，室友拿着我的包在附近等。

examples.en: I asked the nurse which treatment cubicle my friend had been taken to that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问护士那天下午我朋友被带去了哪个「诊疗隔间」。

words.enDefinition: an equipped emergency care area for critically ill patients

examples.en: The map showed the resuscitation bay near the ambulance entrance rather than beside the main doors.
examples.zh: 地图上「复苏抢救区」靠近救护车入口，不在大门旁边。

examples.en: The nurse told us where to wait while the team worked in the resuscitation bay.
examples.zh: 医疗团队在「复苏抢救区」工作时，护士告诉我们该在哪里等候。

collocations: move a patient to the resuscitation bay

words.enDefinition: specialists who work together to care for major injuries

examples.en: The nurse said the trauma team had received the notes from the ambulance crew.
examples.zh: 护士说，「创伤救治团队」已经收到了救护人员的记录。

examples.en: My friend asked who on the trauma team could give an update to the family.
examples.zh: 朋友问「创伤救治团队」里有谁能给家属通报情况。

collocations: a member of the trauma team

words.enDefinition: a unit for patients expected to need simpler care

examples.en: The nurse directed me to the fast-track area after looking at my assessment notes.
examples.zh: 护士看过我的评估记录后，指引我去「快速诊疗区」。

examples.en: I asked whether my roommate could wait with me in the fast-track area that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问那天下午室友能不能陪我在「快速诊疗区」等候。

collocations: direct someone to the fast-track area

words.enDefinition: a hospital unit for patients requiring short-term monitoring

examples.en: The doctor told me I would move to the observation unit once a bed became free.
examples.zh: 医生说，空出床位后我会转到「留观病区」。

examples.en: My flatmate brought my charger after finding the observation unit on the hospital map.
examples.zh: 室友在医院地图上找到「留观病区」后，把我的充电器送了过来。

words.enDefinition: a hospital bed used while a patient is monitored

examples.en: The nurse was waiting for an observation bed to become available on the next floor.
examples.zh: 护士在等相邻楼层的「留观床位」空出来。

examples.en: The team explained how my friend could find me once I had an observation bed.
examples.zh: 团队解释了我有「留观床位」后，朋友可以怎么找到我。

words.enDefinition: to retain a patient temporarily for ongoing assessment

examples.en: The doctor used the words keep under observation when explaining why I would stay longer.
examples.zh: 医生用「继续留院观察」解释我为什么需要多待一会儿。

examples.en: The nurse explained how the team decides which patients to keep under observation after assessment.
examples.zh: 护士说明团队在评估后怎么决定让哪些患者「继续留院观察」。

collocations: decide whom to keep under observation

words.enDefinition: a monitored hospital stay lasting through the night

examples.en: I called my roommate after the doctor said I would stay for overnight observation.
examples.zh: 医生说我要「留院过夜观察」后，我给室友打了电话。

examples.en: The staff member showed me where to leave my belongings before overnight observation began.
examples.zh: 工作人员告诉我，「留院过夜观察」开始前可以把随身物品放在哪里。

collocations: after a period of overnight observation

words.enDefinition: ongoing tracking of a patient's condition over time

examples.en: The nurse explained where my visitor could sit during continuous monitoring in the next room.
examples.zh: 护士说明了我在隔壁房间接受「持续监测」期间，访客可以坐在哪里。

examples.en: The summary mentioned continuous monitoring without listing the individual measurements from that evening's visit.
examples.zh: 摘要提到了「持续监测」，没有列出当天晚上就诊时的每次测量数据。

words.enDefinition: a device that tracks the heart's activity over time

examples.en: I asked the nurse what the beeping from the cardiac monitor next to my bed meant.
examples.zh: 我问护士，床边「心脏监护仪」发出来的哔哔声是什么意思。

examples.en: The nurse checked the name on the chart before connecting the cardiac monitor beside me.
examples.zh: 护士先核对记录表上的姓名，再连接我身旁的「心脏监护仪」。

words.enDefinition: a measurement of the percentage of hemoglobin carrying oxygen

examples.en: The nurse recorded the oxygen saturation reading alongside the other numbers from my assessment.
examples.zh: 护士把「血氧饱和度读数」和我评估时的其他数据一起记录下来。

examples.en: The doctor reviewed my oxygen saturation reading while checking the notes from the emergency department.
examples.zh: 医生核对急诊科记录时，看了我的「血氧饱和度读数」。

words.enDefinition: the number of breaths taken in a specified time

examples.en: The nurse recorded my respiratory rate along with my temperature shortly after I arrived.
examples.zh: 我刚到不久，护士把我的「呼吸频率」和体温一起记录了下来。

examples.en: I saw respiratory rate listed in the observation chart next to several other measurements.
examples.zh: 我看到「呼吸频率」和其他几项测量数据一起列在观察记录表上。

collocations: note a change in respiratory rate

words.enDefinition: a further set of measurements to track someone's condition

examples.en: The nurse returned to record repeat observations before my friend came back from the café.
examples.zh: 朋友从咖啡馆回来前，护士回来记录了「复测的生命体征」。

examples.en: The clinician compared the repeat observations with the measurements taken immediately after my arrival.
examples.zh: 医务人员把「复测的生命体征」和我刚到时的测量结果做了比较。

collocations: compare repeat observations with earlier measurements

words.enDefinition: a chart recording changes in a patient's measured condition

examples.en: The nurse updated the observation chart before handing it to the team on the next shift.
examples.zh: 护士更新了「观察记录表」，然后交给下一班的团队。

examples.en: I noticed my arrival time at the top of the observation chart beside the bed.
examples.zh: 我注意到床边的「观察记录表」顶端写着我的到院时间。

words.enDefinition: waiting until an appropriate hospital bed becomes available

examples.en: The status showed awaiting a bed, so I asked which desk could explain the delay.
examples.zh: 状态显示「等待床位」，我就问哪个服务台可以解释延误。

examples.en: I was still awaiting a bed when my friend returned with a charger that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上朋友带充电器回来时，我还在「等待床位」。

words.enDefinition: waiting for a medical imaging examination to take place

examples.en: The tracker showed awaiting imaging even though the team had already explained the next step.
examples.zh: 团队虽然已经讲了下一步，进度页面仍显示「等待影像检查」。

examples.en: I was awaiting imaging when my roommate called to ask which hospital building I was in.
examples.zh: 室友打来问我在哪栋医院楼里时，我正「等待影像检查」。

words.enDefinition: waiting for a clinician to examine existing information

examples.en: The doctor said the notes were awaiting review by the team responsible for the ward.
examples.zh: 医生说，记录在「等待临床复核」，由负责病区的团队处理。

examples.en: The portal showed awaiting review after the new entry appeared in my visit record.
examples.zh: 就诊档案里出现新记录后，平台显示「等待临床复核」。

words.enDefinition: a band worn on the wrist identifying a patient

examples.en: The receptionist gave me a patient wristband after asking me to spell my surname.
examples.zh: 前台请我拼写姓氏后，给了我一条「患者腕带」。

examples.en: I noticed a misspelling on my patient wristband and asked the nurse to check it.
examples.zh: 我看到「患者腕带」上有拼写错误，就请护士核对。

words.enDefinition: verification of a patient's identity using a wristband

examples.en: The nurse did a wristband check before handing my notes to a different member of staff.
examples.zh: 护士先做了「腕带身份核对」，再把记录交给另一位工作人员。

examples.en: The porter said the wristband check would help confirm he had found the right patient.
examples.zh: 运送人员说，「腕带身份核对」能帮助确认他找对了患者。

words.enDefinition: a label displaying information that identifies a specific patient

examples.en: The nurse checked the patient label before attaching it to the outside of my folder.
examples.zh: 护士先核对「患者身份标签」，再贴到我文件夹外面。

examples.en: I noticed that the patient label and wristband had different spellings of my last name.
examples.zh: 我注意到「患者身份标签」和腕带上我的姓拼法不同。

words.enDefinition: a wristband marking a recorded allergy or allergy alert

examples.en: The nurse checked the allergy band before asking me to confirm what was in my record.
examples.zh: 护士先查看了「过敏提示腕带」，再请我确认记录里写了什么。

examples.en: I asked whether the allergy band should display my name along with the warning.
examples.zh: 我问「过敏提示腕带」上除了警示外，是不是还应该写我的姓名。

words.enDefinition: notes documenting what a clinician assessed and found

examples.en: I asked whether the assessment notes would go with me when I changed wards.
examples.zh: 我问转病房时，「评估记录」会不会随我一起转过去。

examples.en: The nurse read the assessment notes before asking which details were missing from my file.
examples.zh: 护士先读了「评估记录」，再问档案里还缺哪些细节。

words.enDefinition: a record of a patient encounter in emergency care

examples.en: I requested my emergency visit record because another clinic asked for the date and notes.
examples.zh: 另一家诊所想看就诊日期和记录，我就申请了自己的「急诊就诊记录」。

examples.en: The emergency visit record showed when my friend had arrived and which team saw her.
examples.zh: 「急诊就诊记录」显示了我朋友的到院时间，以及哪个团队给她看了诊。

words.enDefinition: a document confirming that a patient attended a healthcare service

examples.en: I asked for proof of attendance because I had missed a compulsory university session.
examples.zh: 我错过了一节必须参加的课，就申请了一份「到院就诊凭证」。

examples.en: The office sent proof of attendance with the time and date of my hospital visit.
examples.zh: 办公室发了「到院就诊凭证」，上面有我到医院看诊的日期和时间。

collocations: a letter as proof of attendance

words.enDefinition: observations and results that a clinician records during an assessment

examples.en: The doctor explained the clinical findings before asking whether I wanted someone to join the call.
examples.zh: 医生先解释了「临床所见」，再问我想不想请人加入通话。

examples.en: The summary included the clinical findings but left out the time of my arrival.
examples.zh: 摘要包含「临床所见」，但没写我的到院时间。

words.enDefinition: the total time a person remains in a healthcare facility

examples.en: The clerk checked the length of stay before completing the form for my university.
examples.zh: 接待人员先核对了「留院时长」，再填给我学校的表格。

examples.en: I asked why the length of stay in the report was different from my notes.
examples.zh: 我问报告里的「留院时长」为什么和我自己记的不一样。

words.enDefinition: departed before being evaluated by the treating clinical team

examples.en: The record said left without being seen, but my roommate remembered speaking to a triage nurse.
examples.zh: 记录上写着「未获看诊即离院」，但室友记得和分诊护士说过话。

examples.en: The clerk explained why left without being seen could appear next to a visit entry.
examples.zh: 接待人员解释了为什么某条就诊记录旁边可能会写「未获看诊即离院」。

collocations: marked as left without being seen
patients who left without being seen
a record showing left without being seen

words.enDefinition: personal items a patient takes to a healthcare service

examples.en: The porter checked the patient belongings before moving the bed to another part of the department.
examples.zh: 运送人员先核对「患者随身物品」，再把床移到科室的另一个区域。

examples.en: The nurse explained where patient belongings could be stored during a transfer to another ward.
examples.zh: 护士介绍了转到另一病区时，「患者随身物品」可以存在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a bag used to store a patient's personal items

examples.en: The nurse labeled the belongings bag before placing my shoes and jacket inside it.
examples.zh: 护士给「随身物品收纳袋」贴好标签，再把我的鞋和外套放进去。

examples.en: I asked the porter whether my belongings bag was still beside the bed downstairs.
examples.zh: 我问运送人员，我的「随身物品收纳袋」是不是还在楼下床边。

collocations: place items in a belongings bag

words.enDefinition: a loose garment provided for patients to wear in hospital

examples.en: The nurse told me where I could change into a hospital gown before the assessment.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我评估前可以在哪里换「病号服」。

examples.en: My flatmate brought my clothes while I was still sitting in a hospital gown.
examples.zh: 我还穿着「病号服」坐着时，室友把我的衣服送来了。

words.enDefinition: a curtain that separates patients from view in shared areas

examples.en: The nurse drew the privacy curtain before speaking to me about my visit notes.
examples.zh: 护士先拉上了「遮挡帘」，再和我谈就诊记录。

examples.en: My roommate waited outside the privacy curtain until the staff member called her back.
examples.zh: 工作人员喊室友回来前，她一直在「遮挡帘」外面等。

words.enDefinition: a frame used to carry or move someone lying down

examples.en: The porter moved the stretcher through an empty corridor toward the hospital imaging area.
examples.zh: 运送人员推着「担架」经过空走廊，去往医院影像检查区。

examples.en: I held my friend's bag while the crew brought her in on a stretcher.
examples.zh: 救护人员用「担架」把朋友送进来时，我帮她拿着包。

words.enDefinition: a hospital worker who moves patients, equipment, or supplies

examples.en: The hospital porter took me to the imaging department after the nurse called downstairs.
examples.zh: 护士给楼下打电话后，「医院转运员」带我去了影像科。

examples.en: I asked the hospital porter whether my roommate could come with me to the next ward.
examples.zh: 我问「医院转运员」，室友能不能陪我到下一处病房。

words.enDefinition: a button or device used by patients to summon staff

examples.en: The nurse showed me the call bell and wrote her name on the board nearby.
examples.zh: 护士指给我看「护士呼叫铃」，还把自己的名字写到旁边的板上。

examples.en: I asked whether the call bell beside my bed would alert someone at the desk.
examples.zh: 我问床边的「护士呼叫铃」会不会通知服务台的人。

collocations: a call bell by the bed

words.enDefinition: a display providing information for people waiting to be seen

examples.en: The waiting room screen showed which desk to use for questions about the next assessment.
examples.zh: 「候诊室显示屏」上写了，想问下一次评估的问题该去哪个服务台。

examples.en: I looked up at the waiting room screen while my flatmate was getting us water.
examples.zh: 室友去倒水时，我抬头看了看「候诊室显示屏」。

collocations: information on the waiting room screen

words.enDefinition: a clinician's request for a medical imaging examination

examples.en: The nurse confirmed that the imaging request had reached the department on the lower floor.
examples.zh: 护士确认「影像检查申请」已经送到了楼下的科室。

examples.en: I asked whether my name could be corrected before the team processed the imaging request.
examples.zh: 我问团队处理「影像检查申请」之前，能不能把我的姓名改对。

words.enDefinition: the part of a hospital that performs medical imaging

examples.en: The porter showed me which corridor led to the imaging department from the emergency area.
examples.zh: 运送人员告诉我，从急诊区出去走哪条走廊可以到「影像科」。

examples.en: My friend waited outside the imaging department while I spoke to the staff at reception.
examples.zh: 我和前台工作人员沟通时，朋友在「影像科」门口等我。

words.enDefinition: the use of medical images to examine internal structures

examples.en: The nurse said diagnostic imaging would take place in another part of the hospital building.
examples.zh: 护士说，「诊断性影像检查」将在医院大楼的另一个区域做。

examples.en: I asked which signs to follow for diagnostic imaging after leaving the emergency reception desk.
examples.zh: 离开急诊接待处后，我问做「诊断性影像检查」应该跟着哪些标牌走。

words.enDefinition: an X-ray examination that produces images of the chest

examples.en: The clinician checked that the report from my chest X-ray was in the hospital record.
examples.zh: 医务人员核实了我的「胸部X线检查」报告是否在医院病历里。

examples.en: The nurse explained where the chest X-ray would take place while my roommate waited nearby.
examples.zh: 室友在旁边等着，护士告诉我「胸部X线检查」要去哪里做。

words.enDefinition: testing done near the patient instead of in a distant lab

examples.en: The nurse explained the term point-of-care testing while checking where I would be seen.
examples.zh: 护士核对我会在哪里看诊时，解释了「即时检验」这个词。

examples.en: The leaflet described point-of-care testing and listed several areas where staff might perform it.
examples.zh: 折页介绍了「即时检验」，还列出工作人员可能在哪些地方做这种检查。

words.enDefinition: transporting a patient in an ambulance

examples.en: The clerk confirmed that ambulance transport had been arranged between the two hospital buildings.
examples.zh: 接待人员确认，两栋医院楼之间已安排「救护车转送」。

examples.en: My friend asked who could explain the arrangements for ambulance transport to the other hospital.
examples.zh: 朋友问有谁能说明转去另一家医院的「救护车转送」安排。

words.enDefinition: moving a patient from one hospital to another

examples.en: The team arranged an interhospital transfer after another hospital agreed to receive my friend.
examples.zh: 另一家医院同意接收我朋友后，医疗团队安排了「院间转运」。

examples.en: I asked which building my roommate would go to after the interhospital transfer was complete.
examples.zh: 我问「院间转运」结束后，室友会到哪栋楼。

words.enDefinition: the transfer of patient information and responsibility on arrival

examples.en: I waited outside while the ambulance handover took place between the crew and the nurse.
examples.zh: 救护人员和护士做「救护车到院交接」时，我在外面等着。

examples.en: The receiving nurse checked the paperwork after the ambulance handover was complete.
examples.zh: 「救护车到院交接」完成后，接收的护士检查了文件。

words.enDefinition: the transfer of patient information and responsibility between clinicians

examples.en: The nurse explained that the clinical handover would take place when the next team arrived.
examples.zh: 护士说明，下一班团队到达时会做「临床交接」。

examples.en: I asked whether the clinical handover would include the notes from my earlier visit.
examples.zh: 我问「临床交接」时，会不会把我上一次就诊的记录也交过去。

words.enDefinition: a brief written record sent with a transferred patient

examples.en: The nurse checked the transfer note before the porter moved me to a different ward.
examples.zh: 运送人员把我转到另一个病区前，护士核对了「转运记录单」。

examples.en: I asked whether my flatmate could pick up a copy of the transfer note later.
examples.zh: 我问室友晚些时候能不能来领一份「转运记录单」的副本。

words.enDefinition: a request to move a patient to another service

examples.en: The nurse confirmed that the transfer request had reached the team at the larger hospital.
examples.zh: 护士确认，「转运申请」已经送到那家较大医院的团队手里。

examples.en: My friend asked who would review the transfer request and when they might respond.
examples.zh: 朋友问由谁审核「转运申请」，对方大概什么时候会回复。

words.enDefinition: the hospital or unit a patient is being moved to

examples.en: I wrote down the transfer destination so my roommate would know where to meet me.
examples.zh: 我记下了「转运目的地」，方便室友知道去哪里找我。

examples.en: The clerk checked the transfer destination after the original hospital said it had no bed.
examples.zh: 原定医院说没有床位后，接待人员核对了「转运目的地」。

words.enDefinition: the hospital accepting a patient from another facility

examples.en: The nurse at the receiving hospital asked whether the earlier records were already available.
examples.zh: 「接收医院」的护士问，能不能查到之前的病历。

examples.en: I called the receiving hospital after my friend told me which ambulance had taken her.
examples.zh: 朋友告诉我是哪辆救护车送的她之后，我打电话给「接收医院」。

words.enDefinition: the staff taking responsibility when a patient is transferred

examples.en: The receiving team checked my name before opening the folder sent with me.
examples.zh: 「接收医疗团队」先核对了我的姓名，再打开随我一同送来的档案。

examples.en: My roommate asked where the receiving team would provide an update after the transfer.
examples.zh: 室友问，转运后「接收医疗团队」会在哪里通报情况。

collocations: hand over to the receiving team

words.enDefinition: someone assigned to accompany a patient between locations

examples.en: A patient escort met us at the lift and took us to the ward.
examples.zh: 一位「患者陪送人员」在电梯口等我们，带我们去了病房。

examples.en: The nurse said a patient escort would stay until I reached the other department.
examples.zh: 护士说，「患者陪送人员」会陪着我，直到到达另一个科室。

words.enDefinition: a space set aside for relatives waiting for information

examples.en: My aunt waited in the family waiting area while the team finished its assessment.
examples.zh: 团队做完评估之前，我姨妈在「家属等候区」等着。

examples.en: The clerk gave my roommate directions to the family waiting area near the lifts.
examples.zh: 接待人员告诉我室友，电梯附近的「家属等候区」怎么走。

collocations: wait in the family waiting area
directions to the family waiting area
an emergency department family waiting area

words.enDefinition: rules limiting who may visit a patient or when

examples.en: The nurse explained the visitor restrictions before my roommate invited our other friends to come.
examples.zh: 室友邀请其他朋友来之前，护士解释了「探视限制」。

examples.en: I checked whether the visitor restrictions also applied to the area where we were waiting.
examples.zh: 我确认了「探视限制」是否也适用于我们正在等候的区域。

words.enDefinition: a person named as the authorized visitor for a patient

examples.en: I listed my roommate as my designated visitor because my family was overseas.
examples.zh: 家人都在国外，我就把室友列为「指定探视人员」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether the designated visitor had already checked in at reception.
examples.zh: 护士问「指定探视人员」有没有在接待处登记。

words.enDefinition: a document or badge allowing someone into a controlled area

examples.en: The guard gave my friend a visitor pass after checking her name at the desk.
examples.zh: 保安在服务台核对朋友的姓名后，给了她一张「访客通行证」。

examples.en: I returned the visitor pass before leaving the hospital building at the end of the evening.
examples.zh: 晚上离开医院大楼前，我交还了「访客通行证」。

words.enDefinition: a person who helps patients communicate with hospital staff

examples.en: The patient liaison told my roommate where to ask about the updated visiting hours.
examples.zh: 「患者联络员」告诉室友，去哪里打听更新后的探视时间。

examples.en: I spoke with a patient liaison after receiving two different messages about the transfer.
examples.zh: 收到两条说法不一的转运消息后，我找了「患者联络员」沟通。

words.enDefinition: new information explained in person beside the patient's bed

examples.en: The nurse gave a bedside update while my roommate sat with me that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午室友陪我坐着时，护士做了「床旁情况通报」。

examples.en: I asked whether my sister could listen to the bedside update over the phone.
examples.zh: 我问姐姐能不能通过电话听「床旁情况通报」。

words.enDefinition: an early diagnosis that has not been confirmed

examples.en: The clinician called it a provisional diagnosis and explained that the notes might change.
examples.zh: 医务人员说这是「暂定诊断」，并解释记录之后可能会改。

examples.en: I asked whether the provisional diagnosis was printed in the copy I received.
examples.zh: 我问收到的那份副本里，是不是印了「暂定诊断」。

words.enDefinition: a worsening of a patient's medical condition

examples.en: The handover mentioned clinical deterioration and recorded when the staff first noticed the change.
examples.zh: 交接提到了「病情恶化」，并记录了工作人员什么时候第一次察觉变化。

examples.en: I asked the doctor what clinical deterioration meant in the note my friend had shown me.
examples.zh: 我问医生，朋友给我看的记录里「病情恶化」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a clinical state that is not changing significantly at the time

examples.en: The nurse said my friend was in stable condition when I asked for an update.
examples.zh: 我询问朋友的情况时，护士说他当时「病情稳定」。

examples.en: The transfer note mentioned stable condition but did not include the expected time of arrival.
examples.zh: 转运记录提到了「病情稳定」，但没有写预计到达时间。

words.enDefinition: a medical condition not immediately threatening a person's life

examples.en: The team recorded a non-life-threatening condition after completing its assessment and reviewing the earlier notes.
examples.zh: 医疗团队完成评估并核对之前的记录后，记下了「未危及生命的状况」。

examples.en: The report used the phrase non-life-threatening condition and listed where I had been seen.
examples.zh: 报告用了「未危及生命的状况」这个说法，还写了我在哪儿看的诊。

words.enDefinition: a specialist available to respond when needed

examples.en: The emergency physician said an on-call specialist would review the information after the handover.
examples.zh: 急诊医生说，交接之后会有一位「值班专科医生」查看相关资料。

examples.en: I asked whether the on-call specialist had received the notes from my earlier visit.
examples.zh: 我问「值班专科医生」有没有收到我之前那次就诊的记录。

collocations: a review by the on-call specialist

words.enDefinition: an assessment carried out again by a senior clinician

examples.en: The nurse said the team was waiting for a senior review before updating my record.
examples.zh: 护士说，团队正在等「高年资医生复核」，之后再更新我的记录。

examples.en: I asked where the senior review would take place while my roommate went downstairs for coffee.
examples.zh: 室友下楼买咖啡时，我问「高年资医生复核」会在哪里进行。

words.enDefinition: an assessment or advice requested from a specialist team

examples.en: The clinician requested a specialty consultation and explained which team would be contacted next.
examples.zh: 医务人员申请了「专科会诊」，并说明接下来会联系哪个团队。

examples.en: My roommate took a seat outside while I waited for the specialty consultation to begin.
examples.zh: 我等「专科会诊」开始时，室友在外面找了个座位。

words.enDefinition: a fully trained doctor overseeing care in a hospital team

examples.en: The attending physician introduced herself before explaining what was written in the emergency department record.
examples.zh: 「主诊医生」先做了自我介绍，然后讲解了急诊科病历上的内容。

examples.en: I asked the nurse when the attending physician would be available to discuss the summary.
examples.zh: 我问护士，「主诊医生」什么时候有空和我谈这份摘要。

words.enDefinition: a doctor receiving supervised training in a medical specialty

examples.en: The resident physician asked when I had arrived and made a note of my answer.
examples.zh: 「住院医师」问我什么时候到的，并把我的回答记了下来。

examples.en: I spoke to a resident physician while the nurse verified the name on my chart.
examples.zh: 护士核对病历上的姓名时，我和一位「住院医师」谈了谈。

words.enDefinition: a hospital unit assessing and treating acute medical cases

examples.en: The nurse showed my roommate how to find the acute medical unit on the hospital map.
examples.zh: 护士在医院地图上指给室友看，「急症内科病区」在哪里。

examples.en: My record showed that the acute medical unit had received the notes from emergency care.
examples.zh: 我的病历显示，「急症内科病区」已经收到急诊转来的记录。

collocations: transfer to the acute medical unit
a bed in the acute medical unit

words.enDefinition: a unit for patients expected to need a brief stay

examples.en: I called my flatmate after being moved to the short-stay unit on the second floor.
examples.zh: 被转到二楼的「短期留院病区」后，我给室友打了电话。

examples.en: The nurse explained where my bag could be stored in the short-stay unit overnight.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，晚上可以把我的包放在「短期留院病区」的哪里。

words.enDefinition: an NHS service providing assessment and care without overnight admission

examples.en: The receptionist showed me where same-day emergency care was explained on the hospital website.
examples.zh: 前台指给我看医院网站上哪里介绍了「同日急症照护」。

examples.en: The hospital leaflet described same-day emergency care and listed the location of the assessment area.
examples.zh: 医院折页介绍了「同日急症照护」，并标出了评估区的位置。

collocations: refer someone to same-day emergency care

words.enDefinition: formally taking a patient into hospital for inpatient care

examples.en: The team discussed hospital admission and explained who would update me about a possible ward bed.
examples.zh: 团队讨论了「住院收治」，并说明会由谁告诉我有没有病房床位。

examples.en: The school office asked for the date of hospital admission when I explained my absence.
examples.zh: 我向学校办公室说明缺课情况时，对方问了「住院收治」的日期。

words.enDefinition: the clinical team accepting a patient for inpatient care

examples.en: The admitting team called after reviewing the note that had come from the emergency department.
examples.zh: 「收治团队」检查了急诊科转来的记录后，打来了电话。

examples.en: I asked whether the admitting team had a place where my family could wait.
examples.zh: 我问「收治团队」那里有没有可供家人等候的地方。

collocations: hand over to the admitting team

words.enDefinition: a hospital bed for someone formally admitted for care

examples.en: The nurse said my roommate was waiting for an inpatient bed in another ward.
examples.zh: 护士说，室友正在等另一个病区的「住院床位」。

examples.en: I asked what would happen once an inpatient bed became available on the upper floor.
examples.zh: 我问楼上的「住院床位」空出来之后会怎么安排。

words.enDefinition: moving a patient between hospital units or wards

examples.en: The ward transfer was delayed while staff checked that my documents were in the folder.
examples.zh: 工作人员确认资料是否都在文件夹里，耽搁了我的「转病区」安排。

examples.en: My flatmate asked where to find me after the ward transfer had been completed.
examples.zh: 室友问，「转病区」结束后去哪里找我。

words.enDefinition: remaining in a hospital until at least the next day

examples.en: I packed a clean shirt after the nurse mentioned an overnight stay at the hospital.
examples.zh: 护士提到可能要在医院「留院过夜」后，我准备了一件干净衬衫。

examples.en: The letter confirmed an overnight stay during the first week of the university term.
examples.zh: 信上确认我在大学开学第一周「留院过夜」了。

words.enDefinition: a decision about ending a patient's current hospital care

examples.en: The doctor said the discharge decision would be recorded after speaking with the team.
examples.zh: 医生说和团队沟通后，会记录「出院决定」。

examples.en: I asked whether the discharge decision had been sent to my regular clinic yet.
examples.zh: 我问「出院决定」是不是已经发给我常去的诊所了。

words.enDefinition: the official end of a patient's stay or visit

examples.en: At hospital discharge, the office gave me a summary and showed me where it was online.
examples.zh: 「出院」时，办公室给了我一份摘要，还告诉我在哪里能在线看到。

examples.en: I asked who could confirm my hospital discharge for the university absence form.
examples.zh: 为填学校的缺勤表，我问谁能确认我的「出院」情况。

words.enDefinition: the documents completed when a patient leaves hospital care

examples.en: I waited by the desk while the nurse printed the discharge paperwork for me.
examples.zh: 护士给我打印「出院文件」时，我在服务台旁边等。

examples.en: My roommate kept the discharge paperwork in a folder so it would not get lost.
examples.zh: 室友把「出院文件」放在文件夹里，免得弄丢。

words.enDefinition: a concise account of hospital care for a departing patient

examples.en: I checked the discharge summary because I needed the exact date for my college.
examples.zh: 我核对了「出院小结」，因为学校需要准确的日期。

examples.en: The nurse explained when the discharge summary would be available through the patient portal.
examples.zh: 护士说明了什么时候能在患者服务平台上看到「出院小结」。

words.enDefinition: directions given to a patient at the end of care

examples.en: The nurse reviewed the discharge instructions while my flatmate wrote down the clinic's phone number.
examples.zh: 护士讲解「出院注意事项」时，室友记下了诊所的电话号码。

examples.en: I asked for printed discharge instructions because the online portal would not load on my phone.
examples.zh: 因为手机打不开在线平台，我要求拿一份打印的「出院注意事项」。

collocations: a copy of the discharge instructions

words.enDefinition: where a patient is expected to go after discharge

examples.en: The clerk asked me to confirm the discharge destination listed on the hospital form.
examples.zh: 接待人员请我确认医院表格上写的「出院去向」。

examples.en: The record showed my discharge destination as my new student flat near the station.
examples.zh: 记录显示我的「出院去向」是车站附近新租的学生公寓。

words.enDefinition: approved by the clinical team to leave hospital care

examples.en: My roommate waited by the entrance until I was cleared for discharge that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，室友一直在入口等到我「获准出院」。

examples.en: The status changed to cleared for discharge shortly before the nurse printed my paperwork.
examples.zh: 护士打印我的文件前不久，状态改成了「获准出院」。

collocations: wait to be cleared for discharge

words.enDefinition: coordinating the practical steps required before a patient leaves

examples.en: The nurse said discharge planning included checking who would meet me at the entrance.
examples.zh: 护士说，「出院安排」包括确认谁会在入口处接我。

examples.en: The hospital asked whether I could join a phone call about discharge planning that afternoon.
examples.zh: 医院问我，那天下午能不能参加一个关于「出院安排」的电话沟通。

words.enDefinition: instructions describing when a patient should seek reassessment

examples.en: The clinician asked whether I had any questions about the return precautions on the printed sheet.
examples.zh: 医务人员问我，对打印单上的「返院就医提示」有没有疑问。

examples.en: I asked whether the return precautions would also appear in the online visit summary.
examples.zh: 我问「返院就医提示」会不会也出现在网上的就诊摘要里。

words.enDefinition: later care provided without staying overnight in hospital

examples.en: My summary said outpatient follow-up would be handled by a clinic closer to campus.
examples.zh: 摘要说「门诊复诊安排」由更靠近校区的一家诊所负责。

examples.en: I asked which phone number to use when checking the date of my outpatient follow-up.
examples.zh: 我要核对「门诊复诊安排」的日期，就问应该打哪个电话号码。
